card.name: The word the starting a noun phrase
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "The") that begins a noun phrase after a comma, a conjunction such as unless or after, or a preposition. It appears in general web prose such as news and encyclopedia text, not in drug-label text.

modes.label: After a clause opener
modes.description: "the" follows a conjunction or an introductory phrase and starts the subject of the clause.
modes.example: -12:20 – Th or F Quiz times vary; KNE 210 Scientists predict severe environmental consequences from global warming unless<< the>> energy basis of the world’s economy is

modes.label: After a name or comma
modes.description: "the" follows an organization name, a place or a comma and introduces an institution or a role.
modes.example: Health Illustrated Encyclopedia Our Health Information Database is provided by A.D.A.M.<< the>> leading provider of electronic and printed information for

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words that mean "called", "both ... and" and "is/was", so it adds little in English and the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the word "the" when it opens a new noun phrase in ordinary news or web prose.
